name: Modern dancehall riddim
desc: 2010s digital dancehall: 808 kick on the one and the and-of-two with a cross-stick/clap answer on beat three — the halftime bounce that separates dancehall from dembow's boom-ch-boom-chick. Offbeat hats pump; peak adds a kick pickup and open-hat flares.

code.full: stack(s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}).shape(.45), s("~ ~ ~ ~ [rim,cp] ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}*.65).room(.28), s("[~ hh]*4").bank("RolandTR808").gain(saw.range(${gain}*.28, ${gain}*.46).fast(4)).hpf(${hatcut}), s("sh*8").bank("RolandTR808").gain("[.18 .1]*4")).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("<[bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ [~ bd] ~]>").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}).shape(.5), s("~ ~ ~ ~ [rim,cp] ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}*.7).room(.28), s("[~ hh]*4").bank("RolandTR808").gain(saw.range(${gain}*.32, ${gain}*.52).fast(4)).hpf(${hatcut}), s("~ ~ oh ~ ~ ~ oh ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(.3), s("sh*8").bank("RolandTR808").gain("[.2 .12]*4")).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(1).play()
